column1: # Speech-to-Text's supported languages and recognition features, per API,
# location, language and model (#2127), extracted row for row from Google's
# support.go reads it; nothing else decides which feature a model takes.
# Columns (tab separated): api, location (v2; "-" for v1, which has none),
# BCP-47 language code, model, single utterance (v1; "-" for v2), and the
# features the table marks, one letter each ("-" for none):
#   P Automatic punctuation   D Diarization        A Model adaptation
#   C Word-level confidence   F Profanity filter   S Spoken punctuation
